source.branch: Read getpos.c312–553 and the getpos mMoOdDxX caller at1011–1037. gather_locs always includes the hero, applies the selected location filter, and sorts by Chebyshev distance, then y, then x. The uppercase D command lazily gathers GLOC_DOOR and decrements index zero with wrap to the last entry. JavaScript has the key binding and partial interest predicate but no source-equivalent garr/gidx cycle dispatch. Port the whole contiguous helper family and wire the source caller.
